data.title: PAL Airlines Flight Attendants File for Conciliation
data.description: In St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador, flight attendants at PAL Airlines are seeking conciliation with the federal labour board as negotiations have failed to make significant advancement on important matters. Represented by CUPE 5451, the flight attendants have been in talks with PAL Airlines since the spring of 2025, following the expiration of their previous collective agreement on April 30, 2025. This move comes as a response to unresolved issues despite their crucial role in ensuring passenger safety and maintaining community connections within PAL's network.

data.title: Corpay Agrees to Settle FTC Matter
data.description: Atlanta-based company Corpay, Inc. (NYSE: CPAY) has announced a proposed settlement with the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) regarding allegations concerning marketing and disclosure practices within its U.S. Vehicle Payments business. The settlement involves Corpay paying $100 million to the FTC. CEO Ron Clark will not be making any financial payment as part of this agreement. The proposed settlement aims to resolve the FTC matter without any further issues.

data.title: Coresight Research Hosts One-Day Conference Examining AI Impact and Strategies for the Retail Industry
data.description: A one-day conference named Coresight Conference: How AI Is Redefining The Possible is scheduled for September 28, 2026, in Nashville, TN, organized by Coresight Research, a prominent retail and technology research firm in association with Tractor Supply and Soles4Souls. The event aims to provide insights into the impact of artificial intelligence on brands, retailers, and consumers. This conference will bring together retail executives and technology leaders to explore the evolving landscape of AI in the industry.
